findings.evidence: tauri-plugin-single-instance (features = ["deep-link"]) was added, but src-tauri/Cargo.lock has no tauri-plugin-single-instance entry and neither the Step 2 PC nor the Step 3 PC has a Rust toolchain, so cargo check / tauri build were never run on this range. Static reading of src-tauri/src/lib.rs matches the spec (single-instance registered before deep-link, main window unminimize/show/set_focus, register_all under cfg(any(windows, target_os = "linux")) with log::warn on failure; log and tauri::Manager are available, tauri-plugin-deep-link 2.6.1 in the lock provides register_all).
findings.impact: Rust compile correctness of the T2/T4 desktop changes is unverified; the first cargo build will also rewrite Cargo.lock.
findings.recommendation: On a PC with the Rust toolchain, run cargo check in src-tauri and npm run tauri build, then commit the updated src-tauri/Cargo.lock before the Windows real-device OAuth check (spec section 4).

findings.evidence: Installed @tauri-apps/plugin-deep-link npm package is 2.0.0 while src-tauri/Cargo.lock pins the tauri-plugin-deep-link crate at 2.6.1 (pre-existing, not changed in this range). The new code relies on getCurrent()/onOpenUrl(), which exist in 2.0.0.
findings.impact: The Tauri CLI version-mismatch check between npm plugin packages and Rust crates may fail or warn during npm run tauri build (T4).
findings.recommendation: If tauri build reports mismatched Tauri packages, align @tauri-apps/plugin-deep-link (and other plugin npm packages) with the locked crate minor versions.

findings.evidence: On the desktop runtime the effect now skips navigator.serviceWorker.register, but it does not unregister a service worker that an earlier production desktop build may already have registered on the tauri.localhost origin.
findings.impact: Only for a WebView profile that ran an older desktop build: the stale shell cache can persist until the SW is replaced. No impact for first-time desktop installs or the web/PWA path.
findings.recommendation: Optional follow-up: on the desktop runtime, unregister existing registrations once (navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistrations) if older desktop builds were distributed.
